verified_facts.text: The hotel is directly above Montreal's Central Station in downtown Montreal.
verified_facts.excerpt: directly above Montreal’s Central Station at 900 boulevard René-Lévesque Boulevard Ouest

verified_facts.text: The hotel has direct access to Central Station, and attractions such as the Bell Center, Sainte-Catherine Street, Old Montreal, the Museum of Fine Arts and the Quartier des Spectacles are within reach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thanks to its direct access to Central Station and its excellent location in the heart of downtown Montreal, the city’s biggest attractions are all within reach

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been an icon of downtown Montreal since 1958.
verified_facts.excerpt: An icon of downtown Montreal since 1958

verified_facts.text: In 2017 the classic 1960s hotel was renovated by the agency Sid Lee, which created new gathering spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2017, this classic 1960s hotel got a major renovation by Sid Lee, a young, playful agency that created a totally fresh vibe, including new gathering spaces.

verified_facts.text: Guests can book the very room where John Lennon and Yoko Ono stayed for their Bed-In.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can get fancy and book a stay in the very room John Lennon and Yoko Ono stayed in for their famous Bed-In.

verified_facts.text: Dining includes Rosélys restaurant, Nacarat for cocktails and Marché Artisans for local products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy fine dining at Rosélys, savor creative cocktails at Nacarat, and discover a carefully curated selection of local products and treasures at Marché Artisans.

verified_facts.text: Rosélys serves a Sunday brunch buffet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start your Sunday off right with our legendary brunch buffet
treat yourself to a rejuvenating experience at Moment Spa

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool, a hot tub and saunas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a serene oasis at our indoor pool. Enjoy a refreshing swim in the calming ambiance, or melt away stress in the soothing hot tub or saunas.

verified_facts.text: The Wellness Center fitness facility is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Fairmont Gold rooms and suites on floors 18-19 include lounge access with deluxe continental breakfast and cocktail hour hors d'oeuvres.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gold lounge access includes deluxe continental breakfast and cocktail hour hors doeuvres, City skyline views, Chromecast technology, Bathroom with bathtub, Located on floors 18-19

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe 2 Queens room is described as ideal for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathroom with bathtub, Ideal for families

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly; guests contact reservations for fees and restrictions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes we are a pet-friendly hotel! Please contact our reservations team

verified_facts.text: Parking is available at an additional fee, indoor with valet service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

verified_facts.text: Montreal-Trudeau International Airport is the nearest airport, 20 minutes away by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest airport is Montreal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL). It takes 20 minutes to get to our luxury hotel by car.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has business meeting spaces including a Swing room with swings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Swing room even has—you guessed it—swings.
Check-in is typically after 4:00 p.m. and check-out is by noon.

verified_facts.text: Locals often walk through the hotel lobby, and the bar and restaurant are popular after-work hangouts.
verified_facts.excerpt: locals often walk through the lobby just to soak up a little glamor on their way to or from lunch
